results.content:
In a new state-by-state tracker from Civiqs, an online polling firm, more registered voters disapproved than approved of Trump’s job performance in 39 states.

The list includes Democratic strongholds like New York, California and Illinois, as well as some reliably Republican states such as Nebraska, Kentucky and Tennessee. In Texas, for instance, 57 percent of voters disapprove of Trump’s job performance, as do 54 percent in Florida.

results.content:
## By the Numbers

When Trump took office for his second term on January 20, 2025, 62 percent of white registered voters in Kentucky approved of Trump’s performance and 33 percent disapproved, according to Civiqs polling, for a net rating of plus 29 points for the president.

By September 24, 2026, approval had fallen to 43 percent, while disapproval stood at 46 percent, a massive 32-point plunge in net approval from the voting bloc.

Texas also began from a commanding position.
